title: Parent Ambassador Registration Form
intro: Parents are among the most important voices in education. The School Expert™ Parent Ambassador Program gives parents an opportunity to help build a stronger, more connected education ecosystem.
☐ Spread awareness about The School Expert™
☐ Introduce other parents to our community
☐ Share The School Expert™ through reels, posts, WhatsApp and word-of-mouth
☐ Refer schools to The School Expert™ and introduce us to school management
☐ Help parents discover schools, education providers, courses, experts and services
☐ Share parent feedback, ideas and local education insights

This is a voluntary community role. Where a school successfully signs up for a paid listing or service with The School Expert™ through a verified Parent Ambassador referral, a small referral commission will be paid, subject to the applicable referral terms.
Parents know better. We help them choose the best.

sections.title: Referral Programme
sections.description:
Parent Ambassador Referral Commission
Parent Ambassadors may receive a small referral commission when a school signs up for a paid service or listing with The School Expert™ as a result of a verified referral made by the Parent Ambassador.
The referral should be identifiable and registered with The School Expert™ before or during the school's onboarding process.
Commission eligibility, amount, payment timeline and applicable terms will be communicated separately by The School Expert™ and may be updated from time to time.

fields.label: Do you agree to participate in the Parent Ambassador Referral Programme?

sections.title: Code Of Conduct & Declaration
sections.description: Parent Ambassador Declaration. I understand that the Parent Ambassador role is a voluntary community role. I will represent The School Expert™ responsibly and respectfully. I will not make false claims, guarantee outcomes, misrepresent pricing or services, or make commitments on behalf of The School Expert™ without authorization.

fields.label: Code Of Conduct & Declaration
options: Becoming a Parent Ambassador does not constitute employment with The School Expert™.
Referral commissions apply only to eligible, verified and successful referrals.
A referral does not automatically guarantee a commission.
The School Expert™ may provide guidelines and approved materials for promotional activities.
I will respect the privacy of parents, schools and other community members.
I will not use The School Expert™ name or logo for unauthorized purposes.
